input.summary: Add ownership of Content, Site deliverables and customer data, with licence-back of HDI materials
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership, so HDI would own the Site it builds and hosts and there is no licence back to us. We have confirmed that the Company owns its Content, the Site deliverables and all customer and user data, with HDI retaining its pre-existing tools and granting us a perpetual royalty-free licence to anything embedded in the Site.

ops.text: Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company owns all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Site (including all designs, code, text, images and other deliverables created for the Company under this Agreement, which HDI hereby assigns to the Company), the Marks, and all customer and user data collected through the Site. HDI retains ownership of its pre-existing and generally applicable tools, software and know-how, and grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any such HDI materials to the extent embedded in or necessary to operate the Site. No joint ownership is created by this Agreement.

input.summary: Extend the access/use right to Company affiliates and contractors and to successors
input.comment: [Playbook] The access and use right in Section 1.4 covers only the Company itself; we have extended it to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf and confirmed it transfers to a successor, consistent with the assignment provision.

ops.oldText: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated
ops.newText: the right to use (including by the Company's affiliates and by contractors acting on the Company's behalf, and by any successor to the Company), a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated

input.summary: Limit HDI's records inspection to once per 12 months
input.comment: [Playbook] Inspection rights against us must be limited in frequency; we have capped HDI's inspection at once in any twelve-month period. Notice, business hours and HDI cost-bearing already meet our position.

ops.oldText: may upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company, have the right to inspect
ops.newText: may, no more than once in any twelve (12) month period and upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company, have the right to inspect

input.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not pay liquidated damages; the Termination Payment formula (half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000) is an uncapped penalty on us alone. We have capped it at three months' fees as the sole amount payable on termination.

ops.oldText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two
ops.newText: the amount of which shall not exceed the aggregate amounts paid by the Company to HDI under Section 3.1 during the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date, which shall be the sole amount payable by the Company in respect of termination
